0022600002.text: The New York Knicks host the Philadelphia 76ers as both teams open their 2026-27 seasons. This season's series has no games yet, but the teams split their 2025-26 regular-season meetings 2-2, and the Knicks won the 2025-26 playoff series 4-0, including a 144-114 win in Philadelphia on May 10, 2026. For the Knicks, Josh Hart is day-to-day with ankle soreness and is a game-time decision, while the 76ers are without Ariel Hukporti, who is out with a ruptured Achilles, and have Adem Bona, Anfernee Simons, Dean Wade, Dominick Barlow and Tacko Fall listed as day-to-day, all of them game-time decisions, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Knicks a 55% chance to win.
